findings.reason: The original standalone tiles and frozen/current source show only prose for the two-stage spectral decomposition. A concrete commuting triangle materially clarifies how the finer joint-residue projectors regroup into central content sectors, and distinguishes noncentral residue projectors from central content sums. This is a warranted explanatory addition under the expanded diagram criterion, rather than a claim that the original proof is incomplete.
findings.action: Appended an independently captioned TikZ triangle in existing Remarks, with exact direct sums and formulas for all maps; retained zero-sector and no-primitivity caveats.

correction: Added the right-H-module isomorphism triangle H -> R -> C, H -> C, for R the joint-residue sum and C the central-content sum; explicitly defined regrouping G and stated commutativity. Compact R,C labels avoid native lower-limit clipping encountered during local development.

diagram_math_checks.justification: The local charged-specialization definition fixes I=Z/eZ and H=H_d^Lambda. Statement and proof 4.1 give e(nu) for nu in I^d. Caption defines cont(nu)=sum_r alpha_{nu_r}; grouping those sequences gives precisely the height-d contents of Statement and step 5.1. R=sum_direct_nu e(nu)H and C=sum_direct_alpha e_alpha H are right H-modules; no left-H stability of individual residue spaces is asserted.

Phi_res:H->R sends h to (e(nu)h). Orthogonality and sum-to-one in step 4.1 give inverse (h_nu)->sum_nu h_nu. Phi_cont:H->C uses e_alpha in exactly the same way by step 5.1. G:R->C sums the components with fixed content, which lie in e_alpha H since e_alpha e(nu)=e(nu). Its inverse sends (k_alpha) to (e(nu)k_cont(nu))_nu. Every map is right-H-linear because it uses left multiplication or sums. The finite index sets make all sums finite.

The three directed edges are H->R (Phi_res), H->C (Phi_cont), R->C (G). For each h, the alpha component of G Phi_res(h) is sum_cont(nu)=alpha e(nu)h=e_alpha h by the displayed definition of e_alpha in Statement/step 5.1. Thus G Phi_res=Phi_cont. There is no extra edge, inverse arrow, or unsupported relation.
